m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Welcome back, Initiate. You look like you've seen a ghost. Perhaps you have, perhaps you have. But you got the Tusks, eh?
You're the one who spoke with the Auroracle, aren't you? Amazing, isn't she? Went to see her myself once. Been a long time since those days.
Her words inspired me to leave my people, to leave Polaris. That's what led me here. That's a story for another day though, don't you know.
I've been looking into this Land and Sky business. Turns out the idea came from Mammoth Tusk Inscriptions made by Polaris's first inhabitants.
I've traced the Tusks to three caves back in Polaris. I'll mark 'em on your map. Get the Tusks, and I'll translate 'em, okay? All right then.
Hey there, I forgot to say that it's been a pleasure to meet you. I'm excited to talk more when you come back with those Tusks. Good luck!
